old: Sāmānya produces oneness, while viśeṣa produces separateness; sāmānya is indeed likeness of things, and viśeṣa is the opposite.
new: Sameness (sāmānya) produces oneness, while difference (viśeṣa) produces separateness; sameness is indeed likeness of things, and difference is the opposite.
why: reviewer (minor): Inconsistent with 44, which renders 'Sameness (sāmānya)' and 'difference (viśeṣa)'; here bare Sanskrit is used.

old: शब्द आदि अर्थों सहित गुरु आदि, बुद्धि, तथा प्रयत्न तक के पर आदि — ये गुण कहे गए हैं; प्रयत्न-पूर्वक होने वाली चेष्टा कर्म कहलाती है।
new: अर्थों सहित गुरु आदि, बुद्धि, तथा प्रयत्न तक के पर आदि — ये गुण कहे गए हैं; प्रयत्न-पूर्वक होने वाली चेष्टा कर्म कहलाती है।
why: reviewer (error): 'शब्द आदि' (sound etc.) is not in the verse; the text says only sārthāḥ 'with the arthas'. The list belongs in notes (already there).
reviewer (minor): Labelled f.; as a bahuvrīhi it refers to the substances (dravya), so n. (the form is the same in all genders).
reviewer (minor): 'ger.' is ambiguous (reads as gerund/absolutive); kartavya is a gerundive (kṛtya).

old: Pitta is slightly unctuous, hot, sharp, liquid, sour, flowing (sara) and pungent; it is quickly pacified by substances with opposite qualities.
new: Pitta is unctuous (sasneha), hot, sharp, liquid, sour, flowing (sara) and pungent; it is quickly pacified by substances with opposite qualities.
why: reviewer (error): 'slightly' is the commentators' reading added to the translation; sasneha means 'with unctuousness'. The note already records the commentary.

old: पित्त थोड़ी स्निग्धता वाला, उष्ण, तीक्ष्ण, द्रव, अम्ल, सर और कटु है; वह विपरीत गुणों वाले द्रव्यों से शीघ्र शान्त होता है।
new: पित्त स्नेह से युक्त, उष्ण, तीक्ष्ण, द्रव, अम्ल, सर और कटु है; वह विपरीत गुणों वाले द्रव्यों से शीघ्र शान्त होता है।
why: reviewer (error): Same addition ('थोड़ी') as in the English.
reviewer (minor): Gloss gives the commentarial 'slightly unctuous' instead of the literal sense.

old: guṇakarmāṇi (pl.) with singular vakṣyate is a loose agreement; some editions read guṇakarma ca vakṣyate. Not changed.
new: guṇakarmāṇi is the acc. pl. object of vakṣyate (3 sg. fut. middle, the teacher as the implied subject: '(he) will state the qualities and actions'); there is no agreement problem. The English passive is idiomatic.
why: reviewer (error): Unsupported variant claim (no witness given; invented-variant risk), and the 'loose agreement' is not real: guṇakarmāṇi can be accusative object of the middle future vakṣyate.
reviewer (minor): Labelled nom. pl.; it is the object of vakṣyate.
reviewer (minor): '(passive sense)' fits 43 (vedaḥ nom.) but not here, where the object is accusative.

old: मल, मूत्र, चर्म, वीर्य, अस्थि, स्नायु, सींग, नख, खुर, केश, रोम और गोरोचन — ये जांगम द्रव्यों से लेकर प्रयोग में लाए जाते हैं।
new: मल, मूत्र, चर्म, वीर्य, अस्थि, स्नायु, सींग, नख, खुर, केश, रोम और रोचना — ये जांगम द्रव्यों से लेकर प्रयोग में लाए जाते हैं।
why: reviewer (minor): Puts the identification (gorocanā) into the translation; the text says rocanā, and the English keeps 'rocanā'. Identification belongs in notes (it is there).
reviewer (minor): Gloss states the identification as fact; the glossary rule keeps identifications in notes.

old: सोना, मल सहित पाँच धातुएँ, बालू, सुधा अर्थात् चूना, मैनसिल और हरताल, मणियाँ, लवण, गेरू और अञ्जन —
new: सोना, मल सहित पाँच लोह, बालू, सुधा अर्थात् चूना, मैनसिल और हरताल, मणियाँ, लवण, गेरू और अञ्जन —
why: reviewer (minor): धातु is the glossary's fixed Hindi for the body's dhātus (used in 53 and 67); using it for loha (metals) here invites confusion.
